definitions.explanation: A container for disposing of waste and garbage. Can be found in homes, offices, public spaces, and streets.

examples.japanese: ゴミ{箱|ばこ}にゴミを{捨|す}ててください。
examples.english: Please throw your trash in the garbage bin.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}にゴミ{箱|ばこ}が{見当|みあ}たらない。
examples.english: I can't find a trash can at the station.

examples.japanese: {分別|ぶんべつ}ゴミ{箱|ばこ}が{設置|せっち}されている。

notes:
ORTHOGRAPHY:
Often written as ゴミ{箱|ばこ}, {塵箱|ごみばこ}, or ごみ{箱|ばこ}. ゴミ in katakana is very common.

COLLOCATIONS:
・ゴミ{箱|ばこ}に{捨|す}てる - to throw away in a trash can
・{分別|ぶんべつ}ゴミ{箱|ばこ} - sorted/recycling bin
・ゴミ{箱|ばこ}を{空|から}にする - to empty the trash can

CULTURAL NOTES:
Public trash cans are relatively rare in Japan, especially after the 1995 Tokyo subway sarin attack increased security concerns. Many people carry their trash home or look for convenience store bins.

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{屑籠|くずかご} - wastebasket (more formal/traditional)
・ダストボックス - dustbox (loanword)
・ゴミ{袋|ぶくろ} - garbage bag
